description: Serial remote I/O module with digital inputs and outputs, analog inputs and outputs, input counters, Modbus RTU slave
notes: Modbus RTU slave on RS-232 or RS-485; the default Modbus slave ID is 100 and the serial settings are set with the configuration menu (9600 bit/s by default).

Register numbers are the manual's: 00001 coils, 10001 discrete inputs, 30001 input registers, 40001 holding registers (the holding registers repeat the input registers; the counters and outputs can be written).
Two modules can also work as an I/O tunnel (one as Modbus master); this map is for the slave mode.
Register numbers are those of the manual (40001 is the first holding register), counted from 1 (address_base 1).
Written from the manufacturer's manual (in Spanish); not tested on a device.
